payload.body: Discovered during Crate CR-108/CR-112 migration. Crate's Rust POST /api/scan/:barcode now has an in-process 30/min limiter, but exact TypeScript parity needs Frick to expose trusted client-IP/rate-limit context to app routers; otherwise apps must trust X-Forwarded-For directly or reimplement socket-peer CIDR checks.
